summary: One option inside violet-segmented-control: its slotted text is the visible label and its value is what the group selects.

usage.text: Use it only as a child of violet-segmented-control. On its own, a click just fires select-request with detail.value, and nothing becomes checked unless you handle that event.
The parent control owns checked: it sets it on the segment whose value equals the control's value and clears it on the rest. Choose through the control's value, not this attribute.
Give every segment a unique, non-empty value; a segment with an empty value can never be checked. Clicking the segment that is already checked does nothing.

a11y.text: Its inner button has role radio and is named by the slotted text. An aria-label on the violet-segment host is not forwarded, so keep readable text in the slot.
A disabled segment cannot be clicked, and the group's arrow keys and Tab stop skip it.
